text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Mhm, thanks ze ze. Yep, I'll call againlater.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Was that a birthday call from your big<n>sister in
Hong Kong?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my sisters and parents have<n>been bombarding
me with calls and<n>texts ever since the date
changed...<n>Heh, it's hectic, but I wouldn't have it
any other way!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I mean that's true... but I also<n>think they're a
little worried about me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
They think I must be so lonely being<n>all alone in
Japan on my birthday...<n>Ahaha, I have to tell them
I'm not a<n>kid anymore.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, we'll throw you a<n>birthday party,
Crown! A big one, with<n>everyone! Right, Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You can think of me and Cheval just<n>like family!
Right, Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
F-family? Me?! I-I don't know...<n>Would you even
want that?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, of course! I'd love that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Now that I have family in Japanto celebrate with, I'll have to tell ze zeand the others that they have nothingto worry about. ♪
